description.ko: Task·Scope·취소 소유자의 닫힌 소스 바인딩과 스코프에 뿌리를 둔 대여·실행 효과 검사 계획. 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: Concrete plan for sealed source Task/Scope/cancellation bindings, scope-rooted loans, and execution-effect validation; not an implementation claim.

status: owned worker compiler integration implemented; full borrowed-scope and catalog contracts remain planned

scope.approved_target: Full approved CPU Task/library scope remains the target. Owned-static work is an implementation milestone, not a permanent scope reduction.
scope.deferred: GPU remains deferred. Async/await and suspension APIs are selected for0.4. Local executors, hierarchy and detach remain unimplemented synchronous0.3 obligations; they have not been silently removed from the approved CPU scope.
scope.grammar: Use existing imports, type-first declarations, explicit lambda captures, implements/where, Result/Optional, explicit return and statement semicolons. No new language grammar is required for the first source slice.
scope.version_decision: User confirmed2026-10-18: async/suspension moves to0.4; remaining CPU libraries remain0.3.

sealed_types.drop: Nonblocking native scoped discard; Scope retains work. Empty consumed token is a compiler-managed state.
sealed_types.provenance: Separate scope-membership loan, callable-capture origins, and actual result T origins. Recursively inspect T; the handle is a resource capability even when T is scalar.
sealed_types.thread_policy: Initially non-Send/non-Sync; enable only after scoped capability transfer is independently specified.

sealed_types.drop: Blocking structured close/drain; normal Drop cannot silently ignore failed reaping.
sealed_types.provenance: Own a logical ScopeRoot containing admitted child obligations independently of Task observation handles. A movable Scope owner carries its root identity.
sealed_types.thread_policy: Initially non-Send/non-Sync. Full concurrent borrowed registration needs stable compiler-owned scope views and internal-work versus external-handle loan roles.

sealed_types.provenance: Owns independent notification state; retains no user capture, Task Control, Scope borrow or JIT callback.
sealed_types.thread_policy: Can satisfy sealed Send/Sync only through the audited native atomic/registry contract, never through an ordinary user assertion.

sealed_types.provenance: Independent state owner with no TaskContext pointer or task/scope/user-payload loan.
sealed_types.thread_policy: Same audited sealed rule as CancellationSource; cloning cannot grant request authority.

module_and_identity: Use a trusted task module provider with Loader-only CompilerTask/CompilerTaskScope/CompilerCancellationSource/CompilerCancellationToken markers. Source cannot spell these AST markers, construct private state, cast tokens, clone owners implicitly, or supply aevix_ extern symbols.

Resolve every intrinsic through the full callee declaration identity and trusted module provenance. Standard-type specialization must require the original top-level Struct/Enum and exact generic arity, excluding same-named variants and materialized specializations.

A real native-thread-per-task Executor descriptor may expose this supported backend explicitly; do not invent worker pools, quotas, priorities, affinity or worker-count promises. Source Executor/ScopeOptions constructor names require a concrete provider before catalog APIs using them are claimed.
First callable profile is a concrete zero-argument FnOnce producing T. A function with arguments can be explicitly captured in the existing lambda syntax; no implicit capture is introduced.

intrinsic_pipeline.descriptor: New TaskOperationInfo records exact receiver role, consuming/shared/exclusive access, operand roles, Result/Optional/error shape, native ABI, task payload T, callable C, and semantic effect kind. Avoid unvalidated operation-name strings scattered across passes.
intrinsic_pipeline.ast: CompilerTaskExpression carries concrete result type, T, optional concrete callable C, and original arguments. Generic inference returns the authoritative result type and validates FnOnce<Tuple<>,T> after specialization.
intrinsic_pipeline.type_checker: Construct sealed TypeKinds before checking signatures. Validate import identity, storable result layout, explicit owner/guard borrows, thread-transfer/effect constraints, Scope membership, and exact error-carrier ownership.
intrinsic_pipeline.air: Add TaskIntrinsic with exact type/callable/effect metadata. Verifier independently checks capability kind, matching T, FnOnce target, operand ownership, native operation, return/error carrier fields, and non-forgeable place/dynamic-call shape.
intrinsic_pipeline.llvm: Use compiler-only invoke/captureDrop/resultDrop thunks and existing gated native prepare/commit. No source pointer or context address is returned. Preserve per-value initialization flags across every success/failure path.
intrinsic_pipeline.jit: Retain the compilation resource tracker/code/vtables through all admitted worker invokes and capture/result Drop callbacks. Native metadata-only tails can outlive language completion, but global runtime teardown waits them. Do not call the permanent global admission-closing drain after each reusable JIT invocation; use lexical Scope drain while code is live and global drain only for runtime shutdown.

first_source_operations.effect: Create empty ScopeRoot; do not claim executor behavior beyond the real native-thread backend.
Register child in ScopeRoot before scheduling, validate callable effects, transfer captures once; begin with owned/static-safe captures.

Consume observation after terminal take. On native reap failure, snapshot platform metadata and transfer the failed observation back to the already owning Scope only after native discard succeeds; ScopeRoot keeps outstanding capture loans. A failed/not-ready discard must retain the Task owner in an error carrier or safely terminate, never return a plain TaskError while losing observation ownership.
Exclusive handle borrow: NotReady -> Ok(None), terminal success -> Ok(Some(T)) and clear handle, terminal cancellation/failure -> error and clear handle. Other failures preserve handle for retry.

Consume observation only, retain all child capture/result obligations in ScopeRoot. NotReady cannot be silently treated as disposal; it is unreachable under valid source ownership or must preserve the owner.
Observation/request does not release capture loans, consume result, imply completion, cancel on timeout or grant access to T.
Stop admission, drain every child, drop unclaimed results, invalidate native observations, then release ScopeRoot obligations. Explicit close rejects live external Task handles/derived borrows.

first_source_operations.operation: CancellationSource/Token new, clone, token, request, requested
first_source_operations.native: aevix_cancel_* plus core/scoped task token derivation
first_source_operations.effect: Explicit fallible owned state operations. Result errors preserve input owners; readonly tokens cannot gain Source request authority.

scope_root_model.identity: Use a logical ScopeRootId carried with Scope values, not a user-visible native token or a raw source address. Keep hidden admitted-child storage distinct from ordinary struct fields and payload referents.
scope_root_model.child_record: ChildRoot records ScopeRootId, unique compile-time child identity where statically known, capture-use loans, result-contained origins, native-cleanup obligation, and observation state. Dynamic call/loop multiplicity merges conservatively without discarding any live obligation.
scope_root_model.registration: Spawn through &TaskScope is a sealed interior registration effect. Append capture/result provenance to the actual ScopeRoot through the resolved scope borrow before commit. Only compiler-authorized registration may mutate this hidden state through a shared scope borrow.
scope_root_model.after_discard: Removing the Task local or dropping/ignoring Result<Task<T>,E> does not remove registered child loans. ScopeRoot remains a liveness root until safe child completion/drain. This is required even when T contains no references.
scope_root_model.summaries: Extend interprocedural summaries with append-to-scope effects keyed by full parameter/content/projection paths. Preserve them through helpers returning void, closures, aggregates, branching, loops and recursion. Keep target storage and retained parent lifetimes separate, following the current ReferenceParameterPath/field-capability model.
scope_root_model.moving_scope: Scope moves transfer root identity and obligations. Validate every destination/return lifetime against captured referents. Scope cannot escape a borrowed local merely because its public storage is a scalar token.
scope_root_model.completion_precision: A safe first borrowed implementation may conservatively retain admitted loans until Scope close and document that restriction. Full precise semantics should release a child capture-use loan after proven terminal join while retaining any independently returned T references; never infer completion from request/timeout/handle discard.
scope_root_model.close: Close is the special terminal drain of internal Scope obligations; allow it to resolve those obligations while rejecting outstanding external Scope/Task-handle/result borrows. Do not globally waive ordinary borrow checks.
scope_root_model.close_failure: An explicit ScopeError variant can own the closed TaskScope for retry; that error must retain ScopeRoot provenance. Dropping such an error still drains or safely terminates on irrecoverable reap failure. No error branch may return while freeing live captured storage.
scope_root_model.spawn_failure: Native prepare failure leaves the local callable untouched. Source by-value spawn may deliberately destroy unstarted captures according to the existing SpawnError contract; it must not claim to return original captures unless an InputError<F>-style API actually does so. Conservative provenance retention on unknown success/failure is safe but must not be presented as precise loan release.
scope_root_model.region_exit: Check every referent storage-region exit, including scalar locals without Drop, before clearing state. An outer Scope retaining a helper-local capture must make the helper return invalid even when no Task value escapes.
scope_root_model.asynchronous_stores: Forward worker invoke stores and indirectStores to actual caller owners as possible old-union-new contents. Work may not have run or may be cancelled before invoke, and references written into external containers remain after Scope drain.
scope_root_model.loop_multiplicity: A single abstract spawn site may represent several concurrent children. Taking one Task must never discharge all same-site obligations; retain merged capture loans until proven full drain in the first implementation.
scope_root_model.root_generations: Repeated scope creation at one static call site can produce multiple simultaneously live runtime roots. Track an exact-owner identity until re-entry, then conservative One/Many generations or reject escaping borrowed instances; closing one Many instance cannot discharge all roots.
scope_root_model.must_drain_summaries: Consuming helpers require a must-drain summary true across every returning path, separate from may-append effects. A Scope move or close call alone is not proof of drain. Preserve the root through Result.Err -> ScopeError.Retry.scope; dropping the complete carrier drains either variant, while early success release needs actual edge refinement.
scope_root_model.backend_proof: When scoped workers are enabled, public emitLLVM must recompute ownership/ScopeRoot checks or consume a proof bound to the exact AIR revision. Existing owned-only ThreadSafety admission plus structural AIR validation must not become a scoped lifetime bypass.

borrowed_scope_full_target: Permit &T captures only when T is Sync and the actual referent survives the registered child; permit &mut T only when T is Send and the unique loan is rooted in Scope.
Keep shared/exclusive capture permissions after observation discard. A second child or caller access cannot overlap a retained exclusive loan merely because the original Task handle was dropped.
Returned T references need the callable result summary. Reject references to worker-local or consumed capture-owned storage; preserve valid references to longer-lived borrowed storage through join.

Nested helper paths and mutable captured containers need exact per-field target/storage provenance. Unknown nested-reference effects must be rejected until sound summaries exist, never accepted by flattening all paths to a guessed owner.

For concurrent registration captures of &TaskScope, use a compiler-owned stable scope-view representation; copying the sealed native scope capability does not copy ownership or expose raw state. Distinguish internal child-work loans from external handle loans, because close is allowed to wait internal work but cannot invalidate external source references.

Do not let ordinary SourceScope by-value lowering zero/move physical storage that a running worker still dereferences. Either keep stable opaque scope views or defer physical consumption until drain; prove this explicitly before enabling Scope references on workers.
Self-close from a worker remains rejected before any sibling wait. Nested scopes created inside workers are independent and may drain their own children safely.

Scope-root effects must survive generic specialization, indirect calls with verified contracts, loops and error propagation. Native global drain is never a replacement for lexical caller-lifetime proof.

transfer_traits.policy: Compiler-sealed structural Send/Sync derivation. User implements Send/Sync cannot bypass validation, and no unsafe assertion syntax is invented.

rules.type: CPU primitives, unit, owned SIMD values
rules.Sync: yes for immutable shared access; mutable aliases still forbidden

rules.Send: all contained owners are Send and all relevant Drop effects are worker-safe
rules.Sync: all shared-accessible contents are Sync; ordinary mutable access still needs an exclusive borrow

rules.Send: owned bytes transfer safely with audited allocator/Drop
T:Sync plus a valid registered/static loan
T:Send plus an exclusive registered/static loan
rules.Sync: only if the existing exclusive-reference access model proves shared read behavior; never duplicate mutation capability
T:Sync; dyn additionally needs a checked interface/vtable transfer contract
T:Send+Sync; remain conservatively disabled until the sealed trait pass is integrated
T:Send, because shared access to T is available only through a guard
T:Send+Sync because multiple readers may expose &T

rules.Send: no in the current conservative profile
rules.Sync: no in the current conservative profile; recursion must find guards hidden inside owners/closures
audited synchronized request/readonly operations; no implied work completion

rules.Send: only a checked compiler-owned resource contract, including Drop/thread affinity/retained buffers
rules.Sync: only exact audited operations; a private integer handle alone proves neither trait

transfer_traits.first_slice_restrictions: Initially accept owned/static-safe captures/results with no user Drop, unknown dynamic target, unsynchronized global effect or unregistered borrowed view. This is a staging restriction; full borrowed scopes, verified custom Drop and broader native resources remain required work.

worker_effect_check.summary: Build fixed-point per-function/closure/Drop summaries: globals read/written/borrowed with exact paths, trusted synchronized resource effects, FFI/unknown dynamic calls, retained loans, captured data transfer and executable-code dependencies.
global_rules: Zero captures do not imply safety: reject direct/transitive access to ordinary mutable global/persist storage from worker code.
Allow immutable compile-time values and truly Sync shared global data only when lifetime/initialization is valid.
Atomic and lock operations are approved only by closed operation identity, not names. Their hidden interior mutations do not authorize raw field access.
Known-safe code may call other known-safe functions; mutually recursive summaries must reach a conservative fixed point before admission.
call_rules: Check every reachable source call, including destructors executed for moved captures, worker temporaries, early returns and unused result cleanup.

Unknown FFI and unknown dynamic function pointers are rejected in safe work. Trusted native SDK operations require a specific audited typed-buffer/resource/thread contract; do not infer safety from a symbol name.
Dynamic interface targets require a checked effect/Send/Sync contract across all reachable implementations; reject open or unproven targets in the first slice.
A user Copy/Send annotation does not excuse a Drop method that mutates an unsynchronized global. Captured-value and result transfer includes cleanup permissions.
Normal Result.Err is an application value, not unwind or automatic lock poison. Fatal native/process errors do not become a fabricated TaskError.

lowering_and_failure_protocol: Evaluate scope/work arguments in existing source order. Native prepare allocates/admits/starts a gated worker before source capture relocation; failure cannot run or drop uninitialized captures.

After successful prepare, relocate the concrete closure into its exact aligned capture slot and clear the original owner once. Valid commit is allocation-free/infallible; any impossible protocol error must not free live captures and continue.

Compiler invoke thunk consumes FnOnce C exactly once, calls the actual source call target, stores T exactly once, and returns native Completed. Capture-drop handles only cancelled-before-invoke work; invoked closure cleanup belongs to the thunk/source call on every normal path.
T=Result<U,E> remains an ordinary T: joining yields Result<Result<U,E>,TaskError>. A running closure returning a cancellation/application Err is not implicitly flattened into lifecycle Cancelled.
Result-drop thunk invokes T cleanup exactly once if unclaimed. Capture/result thunks and their JIT code must remain valid through Scope drain.

Terminal source result take clears only the observation token. Native try_take NotReady and validation/reap failure retain it. Source Task.join may return a plain lifecycle error after a failed take only when scoped discard has successfully transferred observation ownership; failed discard retains the Task owner or stops safely. Scope capture obligations remain live throughout.

Explicit close failure keeps the closed Scope owner in an error carrier for retry. Implicit Scope Drop cannot return an error; it must safely drain or terminate with a diagnostic, never release captured loans while work remains.
Cancel observers are independent native state owners. Task/Scope cleanup can free all user payloads while a notification token remains; global runtime shutdown must not wait for token-only owners.

positive: Import-only availability, explicit FnOnce capture move, scalar/string/vector/SIMD/128-bit result transfer, nested application Result preservation.
Scope open/spawn/join/close, nonblocking discard of running work followed by Scope drain, early return with RAII cleanup, multiple children and nested worker-created scopes.
Clone/query/request cancellation owners, token valid after Task/Scope cleanup, terminal try_take and running NotReady, timeout preserving work, cancellation request losing to normal success.
Verified synchronized global access through Atomic/Mutex/RwLock once transfer/effect traits land; no hidden Task or guard copies.
Borrowed shared/exclusive captures rooted in Scope after handle discard; helper/generic/loop registration; precise long-lived return references and mutable reference-container writes.
negative: Forged public state fields/native extern prefix, Source-token authority escalation, implicit Task/Scope/token copy, mismatched T or FnOnce signature.

Drop/discard then mutate an exclusively captured referent, borrowed referent ending before Scope close, Scope/error owner escaping a captured local, or second child claiming an overlapping exclusive loan.
Handle/result/view outliving Scope; closing/moving Scope with live external Task handles; closing from the same worker before sibling wait.
Guard nested in Box/Vector/Tuple/closure/result crossing a thread, readonly projections used to recover mutation, thread-affine native resource transfer without contract.
Zero-capture worker/helper/Drop that reads or writes an ordinary mutable global; unknown FFI/dynamic callback; false user implements Send assertions.
References returned into consumed capture-owned data or worker locals, including through helpers and nested aggregate fields.
JIT resource removal before capture/result Drop; source error branch dropping the last Scope obligation after native reaping failure.
required_gates.execution: Check/AOT O0+O2/JIT O0+O2 with meaningful owned-resource Drop counters and deterministic blocking/cancellation gates. Native runtime tests stay separate from source proof. Include Linux ARM/x86 and Windows execution only when actually run, with static cross-link reported separately.

stage_order: Freeze the current native Task/Scope/cancellation APIs after registered native gates.

Implement sealed source types, exact operation descriptor, finite CPU executor profile and worker-effect/recursive transfer proof. Do not expose callable spawn until source bodies, captures, result cleanup and reachable helpers are verified.
Enable owned/static-safe FnOnce spawn, joins, observations, Scope drain and cancellation owners only behind that proof. No-capture closures must pass the same global/FFI/Drop checks.
Integrate ScopeRoot append/retain/drain effects through existing per-field/interprocedural provenance machinery; enable full borrowed captures only after positive and escape gates pass.
Add verified dynamic interface/custom Drop/native-resource transfer, stable concurrent scope views and precise per-child completion release.
Implement remaining catalog families (groups/combinators/hierarchy/executor policies) with real semantics; await/local execution/detach remain separately gated. Full approved CPU target is preserved.

error_carriers.existing_source_type: error.TaskError currently covers SpawnFailed(os_code), Cancelled, TimedOut, AlreadyJoined, ScopeClosed, AllocationFailure and Unsupported. It does not yet represent every native lifecycle/protocol status.
error_carriers.required_reconciliation: Before binding, add exact source lifecycle variants or dedicated task-module SpawnError/ScopeError/CancellationError providers for size/refcount overflow, WouldDeadlock, native reap failure with platform error domain/code, and consumed state. Do not mislabel these as cancellation or fabricate success.
error_carriers.scope_retry: ScopeError.Retry owns the still-closed TaskScope and its retained ScopeRoot provenance after a recoverable native reap failure. This carrier is move-only; its Drop must drain or safely terminate. The original non-owning conceptual ScopeError rows are not a fixed ABI.
error_carriers.native_metadata: Snapshot aevix_task_last_error/error_domain immediately after a failing native operation, before fallback discard, cleanup, any allocation or another runtime call overwrites thread-local metadata.
error_carriers.fallible_cancellation: Publish Result<CancellationToken,CancellationError> for token derivation/clone and Result<CancellationSource,CancellationError> for source creation/clone in the development contract; explicitly reconcile catalog nonfallible token/clone rows before claiming equivalence.

source_signature_profile.status: Proposed concrete source signatures; new provider declarations must pass normal language checking before these APIs are reported available.
source_signature_profile.executor: Use a real closed NativeThread Executor descriptor and a concrete default-only ScopeOptions value. Preserve canonical Task.open_scope(&Executor executor, ScopeOptions options); do not silently ignore unsupported options or invent a pool. Its creation API remains to be implemented with the provider.
declarations: public Result<TaskScope, SpawnError> open_scope(&Executor executor, ScopeOptions options);
public Result<Task<T>, SpawnError> spawn_owned<T, F>(&TaskScope scope, F work) where F implements FnOnce<Tuple<>, T>;
public Result<Task<T>, SpawnError> spawn<T, F>(&TaskScope scope, F work) where F implements FnOnce<Tuple<>, T>;
public Result<Optional<T>, TaskError> try_take<T>(&mut Task<T> task);
public Result<WaitStatus, TaskError> wait_timeout<T>(&Task<T> task, Duration timeout);
source_signature_profile.namespace: Declarations are conceptual members of trusted Task namespace/type provider as catalogued, not plain task-module free functions claimed to be canonical methods. Existing canonical generic return inference rules must infer T from F output while validating the complete closure contract.
source_signature_profile.nonfallible_queries: Source status/cancel_requested accept live sealed borrowed owners, so InvalidToken is an internal invariant breach rather than an application fallback value; never turn corruption into false/not-requested.
source_signature_profile.duration: Existing time.Duration owns a private u64 nanoseconds field and exposes as_nanos; pass that unsigned count directly to the native u64 timeout. Future alternate-unit/deadline conversions must check overflow, never wrap negative values or silently saturate.

current_owned_profile.gates: Task Generic, ownership, execution, system IO, full112-process fault injection, JIT68checks and AIR182checks passed. The complete116-target run had115passes and one resources-fixture spelling error; the corrected resources gate passed separately25positive modes and7negatives. A fresh coherent run including the subsequent FnOnce and float-bits changes is still pending.
current_owned_profile.captures_and_results: Owned only, no contained borrow, sealed compiler-derived Send and transitive worker-safe cleanup/calls.
current_owned_profile.scope_lifetime: Task observation retains Scope provenance even for scalar results and through helpers/carriers/Box/Tuple/Vector.
current_owned_profile.system_calls: Closed print/println/printf/log/flush/input use audited native call locks, no retained buffers, and thread-local errors. Concurrent output/token input and owned nested text Result pass all execution modes.
current_owned_profile.global_storage: Task/Scope owner storage, including nested forms, is rejected globally and in persist until drain-before-teardown and idempotent cleanup are proved.
current_owned_profile.os_calls: Audited time monotonic_ns/unix_time_ns/sleep_ns and File open/read/write/seek/flush/close/size/set_len/cleanup are admitted. time.sleep blocks its native worker and supplies no async or cancellation wake. Environment/process/path/fs and arbitrary foreign calls remain denied on workers.

latest_owned_checkpoint.borrowed_workers: Rejected; the root model above is planned and has not been implemented.
latest_owned_checkpoint.next_batch: is_finished, wait, cancel_and_join, check_cancel and executor are being implemented after this checkpoint; not validated by it.
